portsSource.note: p.1 available models (3-pin XLR / 5-pin XLR LED), logic connections, dimensions; pinout from MX395 user guide p.3-4 (shure/MX395-user-guide.pdf); white/aluminum LED models listed in Microflex_Wired_2019_Letter_EN.pdf p.7

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: Mic level, active balanced; 5-pin XLR male at the end of the mic body (pin 4 = audio +, pin 2 = audio -, pins 1/3 ground), shared with LED In on pin 5; furnished 5-pin XLR female for field wiring; 48-52 V DC phantom, 8.0 mA

ports.label: LED In
ports.notes: LED control input (input only) on pin 5 of the same 5-pin XLR (shared with Audio Out); bi-colour LED ring: logic low (0 V) = green, high (+5 V) = red; active low (<=1.0 V), TTL; connect to an automixer gate output with internal pull-up, ground to pin 3
